# Social Media Experts (SME)

> Social Media Experts (SME) is a digital marketing agency based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. One team handles branding, performance marketing (Meta and Google ads), social media management, websites, and trademark & copyright registration. SME has served 400+ brands and works with clients across India. Slogan: #ApniPehchanBanao ("build your identity").

## Key facts

- Name: Social Media Experts (short name SME; "SME" here is the agency's initials, not "small and medium enterprise")
- Website: https://www.smeonline.co.in/
- Based in: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Team also works from Mumbai, Kanpur and West Bengal.
- Serves: businesses across India, over calls, video meetings and WhatsApp
- Clients served: 400+ brands

## Services

- Branding: logo design, brand identity and guidelines, brand messaging, packaging and print, rebranding
- Performance marketing: Meta ads, Google Search and Shopping ads, lead generation, monthly reporting on leads, sales and cost per customer
- Social media management: content, creatives and posting, done for you
- Websites: fast, mobile-first websites built to bring in enquiries
- Trademark & copyright: trademark search, filing and registration; copyright registration

## Industries

Hotels and resorts, wedding venues, schools and education centres, hospitals and clinics, manufacturers and exporters, camps and adventure sports, beauty and makeup studios, and financial services. Clients include Brilliant Kids Pre School, Brilliance International School, Shivang Furnaces and Ovens, Camp Ethnosphere, Dive Chirala Water Sports, Ishita's Makeup Studio and PlusX Financial Services.

## How to start

- Free Brand Scan: a 20-minute call reviewing a business's logo, ads, social media, website and trademark status, ending with three practical fixes: https://www.smeonline.co.in/#contact
- No long lock-in contracts.
